#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    Half(ll m = 0, ll v = 0) : match(m), value(v) {}
};

vector<vector<ll>> ways(61, vector<ll>(61, 0));

void preCalc() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 61; ++i) {
        ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
            ways[i][j] = ways[i-1][j-1] + ways[i-1][j];
        }
    }
}

ll choose(int n, int k) {
    if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) return ways[n][k];
    return 0;
}

int trailingZeros(int x) {
    if (x == 0) return 32;
    return __builtin_ctz(x);
}

vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
    sort(arr.begin(), arr.end(), [](const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        return a.value < b.value;
    });
    int sz = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); ++i) {
        if (arr[i].value == arr[sz-1].value) {
            arr[sz-1].match += arr[i].match;
        } else {
            arr[sz++] = arr[i];
        }
    }
    arr.resize(sz);
    return arr;
}

ll bestDiff;
ll ans;
ll totalWays;

void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
    ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
    ll diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
    ll delta = a.match * b.match;
    if (diff < bestDiff) {
        bestDiff = diff;
        ans = delta;
    } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
        ans += delta;
    }
}

ll solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
    bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
    ans = 0;

    unsigned long long maskA = 0, maskB = 0;
    vector<vector<int>> cnt(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); ++i) {
        cnt[i+1] = cnt[i];
        if (s[i] == 'A') {
            cnt[i+1][0]++;
            maskA |= 1ULL << i;
        } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
            cnt[i+1][1]++;
            maskB |= 1ULL << i;
        }
    }

    unsigned long long lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
    unsigned long long lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

    vector<vector<Half>> fst(c+2), snd(c+2);
    vector<int> sz(c+2, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < c+2; ++i) {
        sz[i] = (int)ways[c+1][i];
        fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
        snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
    }

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c+1)); ++mask) {
        int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
        int idx = --sz[btc];

        // first half
        {
            int samePref = min(trailingZeros((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c+1);
            int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2*r - 2 + samePref][0];
            int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2*r - 2 + samePref][1];
            if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                totalA += samePref;
            } else {
                totalB += samePref;
            }

            ll winsA = 0;
            int curA = 0, curB = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < c+1; ++i) {
                if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }

            int exactMatch = 1;
            for (int i = samePref; i < c+1; ++i) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0 && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
                    exactMatch = 0;
                    break;
                }
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0 && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
                    exactMatch = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }

            fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
        }

        // second half
        {
            int match = 1;
            if (((~(unsigned long long)mask) & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
            if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;

            ll winsA = 0;
            int curA = btc, curB = compBtc;
            for (int i = 0; i < c+1; ++i) {
                if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }

            snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
        }
    }

    totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
    ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

    for (int i = 0; i <= c+1; ++i) {
        vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
        vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c+1 - i]);

        int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
        for (const Half& a : one) {
            while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) {
                ptr--;
            }
            if (ptr >= 0) {
                update(a, two[ptr]);
            }
            if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) {
                update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    preCalc();
    int r, c;
    string s;
    cin >> r >> c >> s;
    cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    return 0;
}
